verdict.rationale: Jan is documented as a desktop chat app with a local OpenAI-compatible API server. The pack never mentions a Jan CLI or a terminal chat mode. Curl calls to /v1/chat/completions are a developer building block, not an interactive terminal chat session, and connecting Jan to Claude Code is another product's interface, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal
